# Lunette

> Lunette is an iOS app for documenting a watch collection, checking timekeeping and keeping a wear journal. Collection and journal features work offline. No account or subscription is required. The app does not use analytics or ad tracking. Up to five watches are free.

## Key facts

- **Platform:** iOS 17+ (iPhone). Native UIKit app.
- **Price:** Free up to five watches. Lunette Pro and Timegrapher Pro are separate one-time purchases.
- **Privacy:** Collection data is stored on the device. Optional iCloud backup stores a copy in the user's Apple account. The app uses no analytics or ad tracking.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/lunette/id6773048433
- **Website:** https://lunetteapp.com

## Features

- **Collection:** Keep references, serial numbers, movement details, photos, documents and purchase records with each watch.
- **Watch detail:** View movement specifications, purchase records, service history and photos together.
- **Journal:** Save wrist photos and optional locations in a calendar of what was worn.
- **Accuracy:** Compare timekeeping readings against a reference time and review past results.
- **Watch of the Day:** Pick a daily wear and create a story with included gradients. Extra backgrounds require Lunette Pro.
- **Service history:** Log service dates, costs and watchmaker contacts.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Lunette is not a marketplace or trading platform; it is a personal collection and record-keeping tool.
- Lunette does not sync a collection to its own API. Optional iCloud backup stores a copy in the user's Apple account. The Web Companion is a local-network helper.
- The app offers one-time purchases instead of subscriptions.
